test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - GA (Held On 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which is true about India's men's basketball performance at the FIBA 3x3 Asia Cup 2025?

options.text: India reached quarter-finals after 12 years but lost 21-11 to New Zealand.
India's women's team passed qualifiers and reached quarter-finals.
Arvind Muthu scored highest with 45 points.
India decisively beat China 21-19 in Pool B.

solution:
The correct answer is __**India reached quarter-finals after 12 years but lost 21-11 to New Zealand.**__

**__Key Points__**
__

• The **Indian men's 3x3 basketball team** achieved a historic milestone at the **FIBA 3x3 Asia Cup 2024** (often referred to in upcoming sports cycles) held in **Singapore**.

• The team reached the **quarter-finals** of the tournament for the first time since the inaugural edition in **2012**, marking a **12-year** gap.

• In the quarter-final match, India faced **New Zealand**. Despite a strong effort, India lost the game with a score of **21-11**, ending their campaign in the knockout stage.

• India's path to the quarter-finals was impressive; they topped **Qualifying Draw D** and then defeated both **Malaysia** (21-13) and **New Zealand** (21-13) in the **Pool Stage** (Pool C) before meeting New Zealand again in the knockouts.

• The **women's team** did not reach the quarter-finals as they failed to qualify for the main draw, making the second option incorrect.

• While **Arvind Kumar Muthu** was a top performer, the claim of scoring 45 points in the context of a single game or the specific tournament high without context is not the defining true statement compared to the historical team achievement.

**Additional Information__**

• The Indian men's squad for the event included **Arvind Kumar Muthu**, **Pranav Prince**, **Sahaij Pratap Singh Sekhon**, and **Princepal Singh**.

• **Australia** emerged as the champions in both the **men's** and **women's** categories at the **FIBA 3x3 Asia Cup 2024**.

• The **FIBA 3x3** format is played on a **half-court** with a **12-second shot clock**, and the first team to reach **21 points** or the team leading after **10 minutes** wins.

• This performance significantly boosted India's **FIBA 3x3 world rankings**, reflecting the growing potential of the sport in the country.
